$comment: Single source of brand truth for every public asset. The public name is a PENDING HUMAN DECISION (docs/strategy/BRAND_REQUIREMENTS.md, MASTER_PLAN.md §10). Nothing else in site/ or docs/marketing/ may hardcode a name, domain or package scope: they read these tokens. Renaming the project is an edit to this file plus `npm run site:build`.

name.note: Working title only. BRAND_REQUIREMENTS.md documents why this fails as a public brand (ungoogleable, category-confusing, no namespace). Shortlist: Accordo, Pactio, Vinculo, Relato — none chosen. A human must register the name, screen the trademark and update this file before any public launch.

domain.note: RFC 2606 reserved TLD, deliberately unresolvable. Every absolute URL in the built site points here until a human registers a domain, so a premature deploy is obviously broken rather than quietly wrong.

repository.note: Public visibility is a human decision. Links resolve only once the repository is public.

npm.note: No package is published. The scope is unclaimed and follows the name decision.

license.note: MIT is the repository license today. Final confirmation before public launch is an explicit ADR-gated human decision (MASTER_PLAN.md §10.2).

promise: Describe your sales process to your coding agent; own the CRM it builds.
colorsNote: Inherited verbatim from apps/admin/public/styles.css so the site and the product it ships are visibly the same thing.

typography.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
